title: Paid SSC CHSL No substitution required PART (VII) (2024)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.
The small size of his store makes it impossible for him to stock all the items
questions.solution: C)No substitution required

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Professor Singh is not in the office today. I ask you try call him tomorrow
questions.solution:
D)suggest you try calling
the speaker is offering advice on what to do, which is why 'suggest' is the appropriate verb. The structure "suggest you try calling" is correct because it follows the pattern of 'suggest' + 'subject' + 'try' + 'verb+ing.'

questions.question:
Choose an appropriate word that can substitute the bracketed word and complete the sentence meaningfully.
He never (talks) the truth
questions.solution:
C)'talks' के बदले 'speaks' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'truth' के संदर्भ में सही शब्द 'speaks' है। 'Speaks the truth' एक आम तौर पर इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला phrase है जिसका अर्थ है 'सच्चाई को बोलना'; जैसे— He always speaks the truth.
'speaks' will be used instead of 'talks' because the correct phrase in the context of 'truth' is 'speaks.' 'Speaks the truth' is a commonly used expression that means 'to tell the truth'; Like— He always speaks the truth

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in thegiven sentence.
Grasslands should not be foraged and some places are to be closed for grazing.
options: 3) over-grazed and some areas should be
questions.solution: C)'over-grazed and some areas should be'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि'should not be'के बाद आने वाला शब्द 'foraged' का अर्थ होता है 'खोजना', परंतु यहां उपयुक्त शब्द 'over-grazed' है जिसका अर्थ है 'अधिक चरना'। इसके अतिरिक्त, 'are to be' के बदले 'should be' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह बेहतर रूप से सुझाव देता है कि कुछ क्षेत्रों को बंद किया जाना चाहिए।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.
I quietly went out at the door into the veranda
questions.solution:
D)at' के बदले'through'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि सही प्रीपोजिशन 'through' है जब हम किसी चीज़ के अंदर से बाहर जाते हैं; जैसे— I quietly went out through the door into the veranda.
'through'will be used instead of 'at' because the correct preposition is 'through' when we move from inside to outside through something; Like— I quietly went out through the door into the veranda

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Shantanu always buries his head in the sand whenever he explains his professional failures to his father
options: 2) blames the others for his mistakes
4) shows a blind eye against social issues
questions.solution: C) Hides from the truth(phrase) – Avoiding facing the reality or truth of a situation. सच्चाई से बचना या सच्चाई का सामना न करना।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Things that do not come from the ground not safe to compost
questions.solution: D) 'are not safe'का प्रयोग 'not safe' के बदले होगा क्योंकि वाक्य में 'Things' subject plural है। इसलिए verb भी plural होनी चाहिए। Present Tense में plural verb के लिए 'are' का प्रयोग होता है। अतः सही विकल्प 'are not safe' है; जैसे— "Things that do not come from the ground are not safe to compost."

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.
Modest stores and welcoming residents populated the charming tiny town
questions.solution: D)Delightful(adjective) – Causing delight; very pleasing, beautiful, orcharming. बहुत सुखद या आनंददायक।

questions.question:
Parts of the given sentence have been underlined. One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.
Raveena’s daughter Kavya is most intelligent student and she consistently achieves top grades
questions.solution: D)'most intelligent' के बदले 'an intelligent'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'most intelligent' का प्रयोग तब किया जाता है जब कोई व्यक्ति समूह में सबसे उत्कृष्ट हो, लेकिन यहां सामान्य रूप से 'intelligent student' का जिक्र है, इसलिए indefinite article 'an' का प्रयोग करना सही है। Singular nouns से पहले जब उनका उल्लेख पहली बार किया जा रहा हो और वे vowel sound से शुरू हो रहे हों, तो 'an' का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— Raveena’s daughter Kavya is an intelligent student and she consistently achieves top grades.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
The housing loan taken by Ramesh effected his daily expenses adversely.
questions.solution: D)'by Ramesh effected' के बदले 'by Ramesh affected'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'effected' का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को लागू करना या उसका परिणाम निकालना, जबकि यहां पर loan ने Ramesh के daily expenses को नकारात्मक रूप से प्रभावित किया है। इसलिए 'affected' का उपयोग सही है, जो किसी चीज़ पर प्रभाव डालने का संकेत देता है; जैसे— The housing loan taken by Ramesh affected his daily expenses adversely.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select No improvement required.
Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work at a more leisure pace
questions.solution: B)'at a more leisure pace' के बदले'at a more leisurely pace' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'leisure' एक noun है जबकि यहां adjective की जरूरत है जो 'pace' (noun) का वर्णन कर सके। 'Leisurely' एक adjective और adverb दोनों रूप में प्रयोग हो सकता है और यहां इसे adjective की तरह प्रयोग किया गया है। अतः 'at a more leisurely pace' सही विकल्प होगा; जैसे— Although uncountable files stack up on the tables of government officials, they prefer doing their work at a more leisurely pace.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can replace the bracketed word segment in the following sentence.
Classical buildings in ancient Greek and Roman times were (characteristically built) from marble or some other attractive, durable stone.
questions.solution:
A)'characteristically built' के बदले 'typically built'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'typically' का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ के सामान्य या आम गुणों को दर्शाना। यहां प्राचीन ग्रीक और रोमन काल में इमारतों के निर्माण की सामान्य प्रक्रिया का जिक्र हो रहा है, इसलिए 'typically built' सही विकल्प होगा। 'Characteristically' का अर्थ किसी विशेषता को दर्शाने में होता है, लेकिन यहां सामान्य निर्माण प्रक्रिया की बात हो रही है, अतः 'typically built' का प्रयोग करना उपयुक्त है; जैसे— Classical buildings in ancient Greek and Roman times were typically built from marble or some other attractive, durable stone.
Note: we require adverb to modify verb ‘built’ so the only available adverb in the option is A.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.
Allusive handwriting creates a poor impression.
questions.solution: A)'Allusive' के बदले'Illegible'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'allusive' का मतलब है 'implying or indirectly suggesting something', जो कि 'handwriting' के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Illegible' का मतलब है 'difficult or impossible to read', जो कि 'handwriting' के संदर्भ में सही है; जैसे— Allusive handwriting creates a poor impression.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.
This newly arisen evidence could have proved to finally put the culprit behind bars
questions.solution: A)'could have proved' के बदले 'is proof'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह वाक्य दर्शा रहा है कि नया उभरा हुआ साक्ष्य पहले से ही एक प्रमाण है जो अपराधी को जेल के पीछे डालने के लिए पर्याप्त है। 'is proof' इस बात को दर्शाता है कि साक्ष्य पहले से ही उस उद्देश्य को पूरा कर सकता है। यह एक स्पष्ट और सही विकल्प है; जैसे— This newly arisen evidence is proof to finally put the culprit behind bars.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.
If you give away smoking, your health will improve
questions.solution: D)Give up(phrasal verb) – To quit or stop an activity or habit, especially a bad one. किसी गतिविधि या आदत, विशेषकर बुरी आदत को छोड़ना।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence.
They studied during three hours
questions.solution: B)"for" का use होगा क्योंकि "for" का अर्थ होता है एक विशेष अवधि के लिए। वाक्य में कहा गया है कि उन्होंने तीन घंटे तक अध्ययन किया, इसलिए "for" यहाँ सही है। जबकि "at" का अर्थ है किसी विशेष समय पर, "by" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ के द्वारा, और "from" का अर्थ है किसी बिंदु से शुरू करना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
We shall rehearse thrice before the final performance at least we make errors in the dialogues
questions.solution: D) 'lest we make errors'का प्रयोग 'at least we make errors' के बदले होगा क्योंकि 'lest' का अर्थ होता है 'in order to prevent something undesirable from happening' अर्थात 'ऐसा न हो कि'। यहां यह वाक्य उस उद्देश्य को दर्शाता है कि अंतिम प्रदर्शन से पहले तीन बार अभ्यास किया जाएगा ताकि किसी प्रकार की त्रुटि न हो। 'Lest' के साथ 'should' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है क्योंकि यह खुद ही एक नकारात्मक अर्थ को व्यक्त करता है; जैसे— We shall rehearse thrice before the final performance lest we make errors in the dialogues.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.
There was some drawing-pins in my desk
questions.solution: D)There was' के बदले''There are'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'drawing-pins' Plural हैं, अत: Verb भी Plural होगा; जैसे— There are many books on the table.

questions.question:
Read the given sentence carefully. Change the meaning of the sentence by replacing the underlined word with its ANTONYM from the following options.
His father warned him not to use vulgar language at home
questions.solution:
A)Vulgar(adjective) – Lacking sophistication or good taste; unrefined, coarse, crude. अश्लील
Antonym:Decorous(adjective) – In keeping with good taste and propriety; polite and restrained, proper, refined. शिष्ट

questions.question:
Choose an appropriate word that can substitute the bracketed word and complete the sentence meaningfully.
Shelley was very happy (while) I accepted her invitation to her birthday party.
questions.solution: A)'while' के बदले 'when' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि वाक्य यह दर्शा रहा है कि Shelley तब बहुत खुश हुई जब मैंने उसके जन्मदिन की पार्टी के लिए उसका निमंत्रण स्वीकार किया। 'When' सही विकल्प है क्योंकि यह किसी घटना के घटित होने के समय को दर्शाता है। 'While' का प्रयोग आमतौर पर दो घटनाओं के साथ एक ही समय में घटित होने के लिए किया जाता है, जो इस वाक्य के संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं है; जैसे— Shelley was very happy when I accepted her invitation to her birthday party.
